name: Sekikawa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Sekikawa village emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Sekikawa, a village in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 May 1979.

features.role: Sekikawa village emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character
